rune-ward:
A personal trinket infused with protective magic, held as a ward by you or an ally. The holder can spend a Hope to reduce incoming damage by 1d8.
If the Ward Die result is 8, the ward’s power ends after it reduces damage this turn. It recharges for free on your next rest.
unleash-chaos:
At the start of a session, place {{spellcast|# tokens|tokens equal to your Spellcast trait}} on this card.
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range, spending any number of tokens: on a success, roll d10s equal to the tokens spent and deal that much magic damage. Mark a Stress to refill tokens (up to {{spellcast|#|your Spellcast trait}}).
At the end of each session, clear unspent tokens.
wall-walk: Spend a Hope to let a creature you touch climb walls and ceilings as easily as walking on the ground. Lasts until the end of the scene or you cast Wall Walk again.
cinder-grasp:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target bursts into flames, takes 1d20+3 magic damage, and is temporarily On Fire.
A creature acting while On Fire takes an extra 2d6 magic damage if still On Fire at the end of their action.
floating-eye: Spend a Hope to create a small floating orb you can move anywhere within Very Far range. You can see through it and switch freely between its sight and your own. The spell ends if the orb takes damage or moves out of range.
counterspell: Interrupt a magical effect with a reaction roll using your Spellcast trait. On a success, the effect stops, its consequences are avoided, and this card is placed in your vault.
flight: Make a Spellcast Roll (15). On a success, place {{agilityMin1|# tokens|tokens equal to your Agility (minimum 1)}} on this card. Spend a token when you make an action roll while flying. After the action that spends the last token, you descend to the ground directly below you.
blink-out: Make a Spellcast Roll (12). On a success, spend a Hope to teleport to a point you can see within Far range. Spend an additional Hope for each willing creature within Very Close range to bring them along.
preservation-blast: Make a Spellcast Roll against all targets within Melee range. Targets you succeed against are forced back to Far range and take d8+3 magic damage using your Spellcast trait.
chain-lightning: Mark 2 Stress to make a Spellcast Roll, unleashing lightning on all targets within Close range. Targets you succeed against make a reaction roll (Difficulty = your Spellcast Roll result) and take 2d8+4 magic damage on a failure. The chain repeats on adversaries not yet targeted within Close range of previous targets who took damage, until none remain.
premonition: Once per long rest, immediately after the GM conveys the consequences of a roll you made, rescind the move and consequences and make another move instead.
rift-walker:
Make a Spellcast Roll (15). On a success, place an arcane marking where you stand. The next time you successfully cast Rift Walker, a rift opens giving safe passage back to the marking; it stays open until you close it or cast another spell.
You can drop the spell at any time to cast it again and place the marking elsewhere.
telekinesis: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, move them anywhere within Far range of their original position. Throw the target as an attack with an additional Spellcast Roll against a second target; on a success, deal {{proficiency|#d12+4 physical damage|d12+4 physical damage using your Proficiency}}, and the spell ends.
arcana-touched:
When 4 or more loadout cards are from the Arcana domain, gain:
- +1 bonus to your Spellcast Rolls
- Once per rest, switch the results of your Hope and Fear Dice.
cloaking-blast: When you succeed on a Spellcast Roll to cast a different spell, spend a Hope to become Cloaked: you remain unseen if stationary when an adversary moves to where they would see you. You stop being Cloaked when you move into or within an adversary’s line of sight or make an attack.
arcane-reflection: When you would take magic damage, spend any number of Hope to roll that many d6s. If any roll a 6, the attack is reflected back to the caster, who takes the damage instead.
confusing-aura: Make a Spellcast Roll (14). Once per long rest on a success, create an illusion layer over your body that hides your position. Mark any number of Stress for that many additional layers. When an adversary attacks you, roll d6s equal to the active layers: on any 5 or higher, one layer is destroyed and the attack fails; if all are 4 or lower, you take the damage and this spell ends.
earthquake:
Make a Spellcast Roll (16). Once per rest on a success, all non-flying targets within Very Far range make a Reaction Roll (18). Failures take 3d10+8 physical damage and are temporarily Vulnerable; successes take half damage.
Also, all terrain within Very Far range becomes difficult to move through and structures might be damaged or crumble.
sensory-projection: Once per rest, make a Spellcast Roll (15). On a success, drop into a vision that lets you see and hear any place you have been as though standing there. You move freely in it, unconstrained by a physical body, and it can’t be detected by mundane or magical means. You drop out when you take damage or cast another spell.
adjust-reality: After you or a willing ally make any roll, spend 5 Hope to change the numerical result to one of your choice, plausible for the dice.
falling-sky: Make a Spellcast Roll against all adversaries within Far range. Mark any number of Stress to rain shards of arcana: targets you succeed against take 1d20+2 magic damage for each Stress marked.
